title: Robustness in Large Language Models: A Survey of Mitigation Strategies and Evaluation Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Surveyed via literature that uses benchmarks like FLEX, BBQ, and CrowS-Pairs to measure performance disparities, stereotypical associations, and fairness under adversarial stress or bias-inducing prompts.
Surveyed via literature evaluating model accuracy disparities and the amplification of societal stereotypes across different racial groups using adversarial stress-testing frameworks.

Surveyed by reviewing studies that measure prediction quality disparities across datasets from different geographical regions (e.g., comparing model performance on U.S.-based datasets versus Chilean datasets).
Surveyed via literature that examines prediction disparities and fairness across different religious affiliations when models are subjected to stress or challenging contexts.
Surveyed by analyzing literature on how political identity attributes influence model accuracy and fairness in different demographic contexts.
Surveyed via literature that evaluates performance disparities and prediction quality based on the educational background of the demographic groups.
Surveyed via literature that tests for unfair, discriminatory, or non-robust outputs when models are prompted about culturally sensitive topics or subjected to bias-inducing adversarial inputs.
